title: Triunfo e Tormento
based: Adaptação de fã de Doctor Strange and Doctor Doom: Triumph and Torment (Marvel, 1989), de Roger Stern e Mike Mignola.
credits: Roteiro e arte originais de fã · arte gerada com FLUX.1-schnell · personagens © Marvel · sem fins lucrativos

cast.DOOM: Doctor Doom in his classic comic book costume: full steel-grey metal armor, smooth riveted silver faceplate mask with two narrow eye slits and a slotted mouth grille, dark green hooded cloak fastened with two round gold clasps joined by a gold chain, green belted tunic over the armor, steel gauntlets
cast.STRANGE: Doctor Strange in his classic comic book costume: black hair with white streaks at the temples, thin black mustache and goatee, dark blue tunic and leggings, yellow sash belt, flowing red Cloak of Levitation with a huge stand-up collar, golden Eye of Agamotto amulet on his chest
cast.MEPHISTO: Mephisto, a towering red-skinned demon lord with a gaunt sharp face, pointed ears and a wicked grin, long flowing red cape with an enormous high stand-up collar, dark crimson bodysuit
cast.CYNTHIA: Cynthia von Doom, a beautiful Romani woman in her thirties with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, a deep red shawl over a dark embroidered dress
cast.GENGHIS: the Aged Genghis, an impossibly ancient frail bald man with deeply wrinkled skin and a very long thin white beard, wrapped in simple saffron monk robes
cast.BORIS: Boris, an elderly loyal Romani servant with a bald head, a bushy grey mustache, dark vest over a white shirt

panels.p: On the left, {DOOM}; his cloak and hood are dark green, never red. On the right, {STRANGE}; he wears no hood, his black hair is uncovered. The two stand back to back, surrounded by towering flames and grasping demonic hands in a hellish red cavern, the giant grinning face of {MEPHISTO} looming in the fire above them, dramatic vertical comic book cover composition
A cave high in the snowy Himalayas at night, {GENGHIS} sitting cross-legged beside a small fire, talking to a young shaven-headed disciple monk who listens attentively, wide shot
{GENGHIS} floating in meditation, golden spirit energy pouring from his raised hands and spreading across a starry night sky above the curve of the Earth
{STRANGE} jolted awake in a dark old-fashioned bedroom at night, a ghostly golden glow filling the room, surprised expression
{DOOM} in a dark gothic laboratory full of strange machines and cables, turning toward a ghostly golden light that floats in front of him, wide shot

text.t: Sou velho demais para lembrar o meu próprio nome... mas lembro daquela noite.
A noite em que chamei os magos da Terra. Nenhum podia recusar.
Esse chamado... é do Genghis Ancião?
Um teste para escolher o Mago Supremo? Destino irá. E vencerá.

panels.p: An ancient overgrown stone temple in a dense Indonesian jungle at night, lit by torches, dozens of robed sorcerers of many cultures arriving
{DOOM} striding alone into the torch-lit stone temple hall, the robed sorcerers stepping back from him in fear

{GENGHIS} transforming into a gigantic glowing crystal in the center of the temple, waves of white light sweeping across the hall, many robed sorcerers collapsing entranced on the floor, only {DOOM} and {STRANGE} still standing, wide shot
{STRANGE} and {DOOM} dueling inside the stone temple, crackling bolts of golden and green mystic energy colliding between them
{STRANGE} holding up the blazing Eye of Agamotto amulet, a blinding beam of light overwhelming {DOOM}, who shields his mask with his arm

text.t: O Templo dos Três, nas selvas da Indonésia.
Destino chegou por último. Como um rei.
Sem máquinas, sem armas: só magia. Um a um, os magos caíram.
Destino desligou as armas da armadura. Não precisa delas.
KRAKOOM!
Com o Olho de Agamotto, Estranho venceu. Agora ele era o Mago Supremo.

panels.p: {STRANGE} and {DOOM} facing each other at dawn in the ruined stone temple, entranced sorcerers lying around them, mist and jungle light, wide shot
Close-up of {DOOM}'s riveted silver mask half in shadow under the green hood, human eyes visible through the slits
{DOOM} lowering his head, one gauntlet over his chest, rain falling, melancholic mood

text.t: Mas a regra era antiga: o vencedor deve uma dádiva ao derrotado.
Você me deve uma dádiva, Estranho.
Se for para dominar o mundo, esqueça.
Destino não pede o mundo.
Pede a alma da mãe dele. Ela está presa no inferno.

panels.p: Castle Doom, a dark gothic fortress with tall spires on a mountain cliff above a medieval Eastern European town at night, violent thunderstorm, green lightning, lit windows, wide shot
{BORIS} talking to {STRANGE} in a candlelit gothic library with towering shelves of ancient books
Flashback in sepia tones: {CYNTHIA} casting a glowing spell in a snowy mountain village at night while soldiers on horseback with torches approach
Flashback in sepia and blood red: {CYNTHIA} collapsing in the snow as a gigantic red horned demon silhouette with burning eyes rises in the sky above a burning village, wide shot

text.t: Latvéria. Todo ano, na véspera da Noite de São João, Destino desafia Mefisto. E todo ano perde.
A mãe dele, Cynthia, era uma feiticeira do nosso povo, os romani.
Para proteger os seus dos soldados do Barão, ela fez um pacto com Mefisto.
O poder saiu do controle. Inocentes morreram. Ela também — e a alma dela ficou com o demônio.
Boris: “Tentei destruir o baú de magia dela. Victor o encontrou mesmo assim.”

panels.p: {STRANGE} teaching {DOOM} at a heavy wooden table covered with glowing ancient tomes, floating golden runes in the air between them
{DOOM} at night in a gothic laboratory, building a small intricate metal device with tools, sparks flying
{DOOM} conjuring a perfect complex glowing green mystic circle in a dark stone hall while {STRANGE} watches, impressed, wide shot

text.t: Por semanas, Estranho ensinou. Destino aprendeu numa velocidade assustadora.
De dia, magia. De noite, Destino voltava às suas máquinas.
Admito, Estranho: você é o feiticeiro superior. Por enquanto.
Partimos à meia-noite.

panels.p: {DOOM} and {STRANGE} descending into a vast hellish abyss of fire and black rock, hordes of demons rising toward them, wide shot
{DOOM} blasting a swarm of demons with green mystic energy from his gauntlets
{STRANGE} on his knees in hellfire, tormented by a ghostly vision of an arrogant cruel version of himself as a wealthy surgeon in a white coat

{MEPHISTO} lounging on a throne of bones in a vast infernal hall, beside him a weathered stone statue of {CYNTHIA} with a faint glowing soul trapped inside, {DOOM} standing defiantly before him, wide shot

text.t: Véspera da Noite de São João. A única noite em que o inferno pode ser desafiado.
ZRAAAK!
Mefisto mostrou a Estranho o homem que ele teria sido sem o Ancião.
Victor! Pontual como sempre. Quer o mundo? Eu lhe dou o mundo inteiro.
Fique com o seu mundo. Destino quer a mãe dele.

panels.p: {DOOM} pointing at {STRANGE}, who is bound in glowing chains of hellfire in an infernal hall
Close-up of {MEPHISTO} grinning widely with cruel delight, flames behind him
The glowing translucent ghost of {CYNTHIA} emerging from her stone statue, horrified, pointing an accusing finger at {DOOM}, rejecting him, wide shot
A small intricate device hidden on {STRANGE}'s red cloak flashing brightly, shattering the chains of hellfire that bind him
{DOOM} and {STRANGE} fighting side by side against a horde of demons, green and golden magic

text.t: Então troque: a alma do Mago Supremo pela dela.
Feito!
Não! Não serei salva com a alma de outro. Você não é o meu filho!
Um dispositivo na minha capa... você planejou tudo, Victor?
A traição era um blefe. Agora os dois lutavam lado a lado.

panels.p: {MEPHISTO} hurling a massive blast of hellfire at the stone statue of {CYNTHIA}, while {STRANGE} holds {DOOM} back from intervening, wide shot
The stone statue shattering as a radiant white and gold soul of {CYNTHIA} bursts free, its pure light burning {MEPHISTO}, who recoils screaming
The radiant soul of {CYNTHIA} ascending in a beam of pure light toward the heavens, {DOOM} looking up and reaching out with one gauntlet
Dawn over the mountains of Latveria, {DOOM} standing alone on a high castle balcony, {STRANGE} walking away into the morning mist, melancholic, wide shot

text.t: Estranho entendeu: ao recusar a troca, ela já estava redimida.
Deixe o golpe acertá-la, Victor!
AAARGH!
Livre, ela subiu. Mefisto não podia mais tocá-la.
Uma alma atormentada enfim encontrou a salvação.
E Destino segue vivendo com o seu triunfo... e o seu tormento. FIM.
